suite: Quote and admin button event/output behavior with isolated DOM doubles
tests: quote button opens the modal and writes product names as plain text
malformed or non-object quote context leaves the dialog closed without throwing
PDP quote button copies quantity and submits only well-formed selected attributes
listing quote button excludes unrelated PDP quantity and configurable selections
browser-invalid quote form cancels submission without an HTTP request or locked button
product clicks while submitting cannot change the in-flight product or reset entered data
accepted quote produces a success message, hides and resets modal form, and unlocks submit
application rejection preserves input, displays an error as plain text, and unlocks retry
empty JSON response produces the documented rejection message and leaves retry available
HTTP 429 produces the server error message as text and preserves the retry token
server transport failure uses the connection message and restores submit availability
unavailable secure randomness prevents a request and displays an actionable message
repeated widget initialization does not attach another click or submit handler
purchase suppression skips invalid display context and processes subsequent valid buttons
contentUpdated reapplies suppression for dynamically inserted quote products
admin submission previously cancelled by jQuery validation leaves buttons and retry available
admin submission previously cancelled by a native listener leaves retry available
admin accepted first submit leaves native POST enabled and suppresses repeated button submits
admin status-save and resend forms maintain separate submission guards
